long.script_text: Electrician EB supply-ai VFD-oda U, V, W terminal-la connect pannirundhaaru. Motor-ai R, S, T-la. Input-um output-um maari pochu.

long.script_text: Veetla irukkura inverter-ai yosinga. Battery oru pakkam, veetu load innoru pakkam. EB supply-ai inverter output-la kuduthaa, inverter erinjidum. VFD-um adhey maadhiri dhaan. Endha pakkam supply varanum, endha pakkam motor pogumnu fix-aa irukku.

long.script_text: R, S, T pakkam ulla irukkuradhu rectifier diodes. Adhu AC-ai vaangi DC-aa maathum. U, V, W pakkam irukkuradhu IGBT switches. Avanga velai, supply kudukkuradhu, vaangaradhu illa. EB-oda four-fifteen volt-ai direct-aa IGBT mela kuduthaa, IGBT switch aagura moment-la supply short aagudhu. IGBT blast.

long.script_text: Adhanaala VFD power terminals-ai olunga theriyanum. R, S, T, idhula L1, L2, L3-nu-um irukkum. Idhu input, EB supply inga mattum dhaan. U, V, W, idhula T1, T2, T3-nu-um irukkum. Idhu output, motor inga mattum dhaan. PE, earth terminal. VFD-kkum motor-kkum earth kandippaa venum.

long.script_text: Chinna VFD-la single phase input-um irukkum. Appo L, N rendu terminal dhaan irukkum. Output mattum moonu phase, U, V, W.

long.script_text: Analog input. Speed-ai potentiometer vechu maatha, moonu wire. Oru pakkam plus ten volt, innoru pakkam GND, naduvula irukkura wiper AI terminal-ku.
